help.topics.how-it-works.summary: Scan, browse, and check out on your phone.
help.topics.scan-qr.title: Scanning a QR code
help.topics.scan-qr.summary: Open your camera or tap a link to reach a shop menu.
help.topics.scan-qr.body1: Find the Zintriq QR code at the checkout counter, on a table tent, or on a product tag.
help.topics.scan-qr.body2: Point your phone camera at the code — most phones open the link automatically.
help.topics.scan-qr.body3: You land on that store's menu. No app download required.
help.topics.cart-checkout.title: Cart & checkout
help.topics.cart-checkout.summary: Add items and pay when the shop has payments enabled.
help.topics.cart-checkout.body1: Items must have Allow add to cart enabled by the merchant to show a + button.
help.topics.cart-checkout.body2: Your cart is saved on this device for each store.
help.topics.cart-checkout.body3: Checkout uses the payment method the shop connected (e.g. PayPal demo or live payments).
help.topics.saved-places.title: Saved places
help.topics.saved-places.summary: Shops you scan appear under Places for quick return visits.
help.topics.saved-places.body1: Every time you open a store via QR, it is added to Places.
help.topics.saved-places.body2: Use search and sort on the Places tab to find shops in busy markets.
help.topics.saved-places.body3: Tap a shop to open its menu again — no need to rescan if you still have the link.
help.topics.markets-venues.title: Markets & venues
help.topics.markets-venues.summary: Browse multi-shop directories like food halls and markets.
help.topics.markets-venues.body1: On Home, scroll to Markets & venues to explore directories with many shops.
help.topics.markets-venues.body2: Tap a venue to see all tenants and open individual storefronts.
help.topics.markets-venues.body3: Scanning any shop inside still saves it to your Places list.
help.topics.remember-me.title: Remember me & sync
help.topics.remember-me.summary: Bring your saved places to a new phone without a password.
help.topics.remember-me.body1: On Places, enter your email under Sync across devices.
help.topics.remember-me.body2: We email you a one-time link — open it on the new device to restore your list.
help.topics.remember-me.body3: Creating an account also keeps your profile and places tied to you.
help.topics.account-profile.title: Account & profile
help.topics.account-profile.summary: Sign in, edit your profile, and log out.
help.topics.account-profile.body1: Use Account to log in or create a profile with username and photo.
help.topics.account-profile.body2: Guests can browse and shop without an account; sign in to sync across devices.
help.topics.account-profile.body3: Business owners use a separate sign-in and Help center at /business/help.

page.compare.site_builders.title: Not a website builder
page.compare.site_builders.lead: A website is one result — not the product.
page.compare.site_builders.p1.them: Site builders optimize pages and hosting.
page.compare.site_builders.p1.us: Zintriq is a meta-space. No product walls. Boundaries can be built.
page.compare.site_builders.p2.us: The same space can hold a café, a booking desk, a sensor, a model.
page.compare.site_builders.p3.dim: What it is & how it runs
page.compare.site_builders.p3.us: What a system is, and how it runs, are first-class. A live target can stay off the draft.
page.compare.low_code.title: Not a low-code platform
page.compare.low_code.lead: Low-code tools add modules per category. Zintriq has no product category wall — the system is what you build.
page.compare.low_code.p1.them: Module catalog grows with each vertical.
page.compare.low_code.p1.us: The meta-space stays open. What you can build grows; Zintriq does not grow a module catalog per vertical.
page.compare.low_code.p2.them: Website app, CRM app, IoT app…
page.compare.low_code.p2.us: No permanent vertical hubs at the conceptual center.
page.compare.low_code.p3.us: Extend in the same meta-space — not a new product wall per need.

legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
legal.privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
legal.privacy.s1_p1: Zintriq (we, us) is operated by an individual pending company registration. The public website is a portal for the product, download, account, and billing. Creation happens in the Zintriq desktop app.
legal.privacy.s1_p2: For GDPR we act as controller for account and website data we collect. Operator location and server region are not yet set. We will publish them here before paid subscriptions open. A company name will replace this operator disclosure when registration completes.
legal.privacy.row_mandatory_data: Email address, password hash or equivalent sign-in identifiers
legal.privacy.row_mandatory_basis: Contract — to create and sign in to your account.
legal.privacy.row_optional_data: Phone number, when a creator or business feature requires it
legal.privacy.row_optional_basis: Contract or consent — verification, recovery, and abuse prevention. Not required only to browse the public site.
legal.privacy.row_automated_data: IP address, browser, security logs; on the desktop app, device name and OS version; crash reports only if you turn them on
legal.privacy.row_automated_basis: Legitimate interest — security and reliability. Crash reports: consent.
legal.privacy.s2_no_payment: When subscriptions are open, Stripe is our payment processor. Stripe handles card data. Zintriq does not store full card numbers. We may keep subscription status, Stripe customer id, and invoice references on your account.
legal.privacy.s3_p1: Operator location and server region are not yet determined. This table is left blank until they are.
legal.privacy.s3_cn_body: Public service for mainland China is postponed and may open later. These pages do not say the market is closed forever.
legal.privacy.s3_eu_body: If you are in the EU, you can use the rights in section 6. We have not yet published a server region.
legal.privacy.s3_other_body: Local consumer and privacy law may still apply. We have not yet published a server region.
legal.privacy.s4_essential_body: We use session and security cookies so you can stay signed in.
legal.privacy.s4_third_body: Stripe (subscription payments), our hosting provider, email delivery, and Cloudflare. We do not embed PayPal buttons, review widgets, or advertising pixels.
legal.privacy.s4_no_ad_body: No ads, no third-party marketing cookies, no cross-site tracking for advertising.
legal.privacy.s5_li1: Account data is kept while the account is open.
legal.privacy.s5_li2: After you close an account, we aim to delete or anonymize identifiable data within 90 days, unless law requires longer (for example invoices).
legal.privacy.s5_li3: Projects that stay only on your computer are yours to delete. Synced or hosted copies follow the retention above when those features are on.
legal.privacy.s6_intro: You have the following rights under applicable data protection laws:
legal.privacy.s6_access_body: – Request a copy of the data we hold about you.
legal.privacy.s6_erasure_label: Right to Erasure ("Right to be Forgotten")
legal.privacy.s6_portability_body: – Receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format.
legal.privacy.s6_withdraw_body: – Withdraw your consent to cross-border data transfer at any time (by deleting your account).
legal.privacy.s6_exercise: To exercise these rights, submit a verifiable request via:
legal.privacy.s7_p: We use TLS in transit, access controls, and Cloudflare for the public site. No transmission is perfectly secure.
legal.privacy.s8_global_body: The service is not for people under 16, except as below.
legal.privacy.s8_china_body: If mainland China access opens, the minimum age there is 14 with guardian consent.
legal.privacy.s8_p: We do not knowingly collect data from minors. If we become aware of such collection, we will delete the data immediately.
legal.privacy.s9_p: We post changes on this page with a new effective date. Material changes before paid billing will also be called out on the site.
legal.privacy.s10_p: For any privacy-related inquiries, data requests, or complaints, please contact us at:
legal.privacy.s10_li_cn: For Chinese users, we will respond within 15 working days as required by PIPL.
legal.privacy.s10_li_eu: For EU users, we will respond within 30 days as required by GDPR.

legal.cookies.heading: Cookie Policy
legal.cookies.s1_p: Cookies are small text files stored on your device (computer, smartphone, tablet) when you visit a website. They are widely used to make websites work more efficiently and to provide information to the site owners.
legal.cookies.s2_intro: Zintriq uses cookies only as follows:

legal.cookies.s3_p: If you continue to Stripe Checkout, Stripe may set its own cookies on stripe.com. We do not embed PayPal, review widgets, or social share pixels. Hardware stores, when linked, have their own cookies.

sec.title: Security & privacy
sec.lead: Creation stays in the desktop app on your computer. This website is the public portal: product, download, account, and billing. No editor, no canvas.
sec.workspace: **Separate workspaces**: data, members, and permissions stay per Workspace.
sec.drafts: **Drafts stay private**: when you publish from the app, public links show the published version only.
sec.ids: **Stable IDs**: each described element keeps a permanent id, so restyling does not break the description.
sec.tracking: **No ads**: this site has no ad pixels and no third-party marketing trackers.
sec.residency: **Data location**: operator location and server region are not yet set. We will publish them before paid subscriptions open.
sec.signin: **App sign-in**: when the app connects to your web account, sign-in finishes in the system browser. The app never sees your password.
sec.local: **Local first**: projects save on your computer. Local-only projects are not uploaded.
sec.loopback: **Desktop factory**: the app runs creation locally. The public site does not host an editor.
sec.offline: **Offline**: coming later. You will be able to keep working without the network. We will publish how long a device can stay offline when that ships.
sec.stripe: **Payments**: Zintriq sells software subscriptions; Stripe processes them. We do not store full card numbers. Hardware uses a separate store.
sec.packages: **Community checks**: when Community ships in the app, shares strip secrets and scan links. Executable payloads are not accepted in the first version.
sec.china: Public service for mainland China is postponed and may open later.

docs.title: Docs
docs.lead: Making happens in the desktop app. This website has no editor. These notes cover the product as it is now, and what comes later.
docs.later: Later stages are marked as coming later in the sections below.
docs.start.body: Download the app for Windows, macOS, or Linux. Create a project on this computer, save it locally, and export a copy when you want one.
docs.build: How to make in the app
docs.build.body: Open a project on the desktop. Describe the system, watch it run, then instantiate. Visual editing is the default; code is welcome.
docs.meta.body: You work in a meta-space: what a system is, how it behaves, what it may do, then a live instance. Objects nest. There is no product wall — you build the boundary if you need one.
docs.publish.body: Hosted publish, custom domains, versions, and roll back come later.
docs.community.body: Community lives in the app, not on this website.
docs.workspace.body: Workspace members and permissions follow paid Team plans once billing is open.
docs.hardware.body: Hardware modules are sold in a separate store when they ship. Plug in a module and edit it in the same space.
docs.dev.body: Visual editing is the default. You can also write code. Custom components and connections come later.
docs.what.title: What Zintriq is
docs.what.body: Zintriq is a meta-space for technology systems. No product walls. Boundaries can be built. Software, hardware, and other targets live in the same space.
docs.what.p2: The product is the meta-system: describe, simulate, instantiate, and build a boundary if you need one. Software, hardware, and other targets use the same space — Zintriq does not sell you a category tool.
docs.ends.title: This website and the app
docs.ends.body: The website is the front door: product, download, account, billing, docs, legal. The factory is the desktop app. You describe, simulate, and instantiate there.
docs.install.title: Install
docs.install.body: Zintriq installs on Windows, macOS, and Linux. Open the download page on the computer you will use. There is no editor in a browser tab.
docs.install.p2: If you are on a phone, leave an email on the download page and we will send the link. After install, create a project on that computer and save it there.
docs.work.title: How you make something
docs.work.body: You do not pick a product category first. You work on a description of a system, then you run it, then you get a live result. Visual editing is the default; code is welcome.
docs.work.describe.title: Describe
docs.work.describe.body: Say what the system is — its parts, fields, and relations. Objects can nest. This is the source of truth, not a page template.
docs.work.simulate.title: Simulate
docs.work.simulate.body: Step the description as a machine: events in, next state out. You can watch behavior before anything is live.
docs.work.instantiate.title: Instantiate
docs.work.instantiate.body: Compile the description into a live result in the app. The product is the meta-system, not a single output type.
docs.work.bound.title: Boundary
docs.work.bound.body: The product does not fence the space. If you need a wall — software, hardware, or another surface — you build that boundary as an object in the same space.
docs.targets.title: The product
docs.targets.body: Zintriq is one product: a meta-space plus the desktop factory. These are parts of that product, not sample businesses.
docs.targets.meta.title: Meta-system
docs.targets.meta.body: Describe, simulate, instantiate, and build a boundary. This is the core.
docs.targets.app.title: Desktop app
docs.targets.app.body: The factory. Library, describe, simulate, instantiate, and space live here. Visual editing is the default; code is welcome.
docs.targets.web.title: This website
docs.targets.web.body: The front door: product, download, account, billing, docs, legal. No editor and no canvas.
docs.targets.sw.title: Software target
docs.targets.sw.body: A system in the space can compile to software you open in the app. That is a target, not a website-builder product.
docs.targets.hw.title: Hardware target
docs.targets.hw.body: Sensors, buttons, displays, and relays use the same space. Modules come later and are sold in a separate store.
docs.bench.title: Inside the app
docs.bench.body: The desktop app is one workbench. You move between library, describe, simulate, instantiate, and space. Space is the document of the meta-space itself: the boundaries you can use, as parts of one description — not a list of separate products.
docs.files.title: Where work lives
docs.files.body: Drafts stay on this computer. You can export a project or a workspace as a file. Cloud sync, hosted publish, and opening a public link come later. Unpublished changes never appear on a public link.
docs.account.title: Account
docs.account.body: Sign up and manage billing on this website. Making is in the app. When desktop sign-in ships, the same Zintriq account is used — not a separate login product.
docs.share.title: Community
docs.share.body: Community is in the app, not on this website. Remix a shared project into your own copy. Share what you make for free when that ships.
docs.hw.body: Hardware is one target, not a separate product. Modules are coming later and will be sold in a separate store. Join the waitlist if you want to hear when they exist.
docs.plan.title: Plans
docs.locale.title: Region and language
docs.locale.body: Region sets prices and hardware notes. Language is only the language menu. They do not change each other. If wording on this site is wrong, write to us — any question is fine.
docs.help.title: Need something else
docs.help.body: Any question is fine: the app, this website, billing, security, wording. For how-to, start here. For everything else, contact us.
docs.ex.cafe: A menu, orders, and a counter in one space — an instance, not a café product.
docs.ex.booking: Slots, guests, reminders — same space, later.
docs.ex.store: Goods, pay, pickup — same space, later.
docs.ex.device: Readings and alerts — hardware as a target, later.
docs.ex.auto: A pump, a valve, a loop that keeps running — later.
docs.ex.ai: A model with an interface in the space — later.

product.space.title: No category wall

product.desktop.title: The factory is on your computer
